# rebar-debug FINAL REPORT — store wedge (P0)

**Problem** — rebar ticket writes (incl. the akitainu completion attestation) were not reaching
`origin/tickets`; the shared store sat 28 ahead / 125 behind and falling behind.

**Proven root cause** — Compaction leaves the tracker working tree dirty non-atomically
(`compact_txn.py:449-466` write→retire→commit with no rollback, in a detached sweep since
`d2dea317ec`). The next reconverge `_union_merge` (`sync.py`) runs `git merge origin/tickets`;
a peer already pushed those `*.retired`/`SNAPSHOT` paths, so the merge must CREATE paths that
exist untracked → git aborts "untracked working tree files would be overwritten by merge". The
handler was abort-only and push-recovery is untracked-blind (`reset --hard` tracked-only,
`stash create` without `-u`) → permanent wedge.

**Proof** — Isolated runtime repro (`/tmp/mergerepro`): reproduced the exact abort (exit 2);
`git stash` WITHOUT `-u` does NOT rescue it; `git clean`/`stash -u` do. Reset path exonerated
(2194/2194 safe FF-adopts). One shared `.git` (inode 976794618) → one wedged HEAD surfaced at
~90 worktree paths.

**Recovery (P0 — DONE, verified)** — Under rebar's exclusive `write_lock`: preserved 232
untracked files, `git checkout -- .` (115 `.archived`), removed regenerable leftovers, union-
merged origin, verified all 28 stranded events + attestation `55cb8610` present, pushed.
Result: **ahead=0/behind=0; attestation + all 28 events on origin; live write round-trip
confirmed.** No permanent loss: the 6 orphaned `.tmp-event-*` were all duplicates (retry uuids
on origin) or debug probes.

**Test** — `tests/unit/test_store_sync_reconverge.py` (held out from the fix author): RED first
for the right reason (captured "could not auto-merge" abort), GREEN after fix, mutation
(re-introduce abort-only) returns it to RED. Assertions are on observable git state (HEAD
parents, reachability, tree, quarantine bytes), not private names.

**Fix** — `src/rebar/_store/sync.py::_union_merge` (Gerrit change **1757**). On the untracked-
overwrite abort only, parse the exact paths git names, relocate them (move, never delete) to
`<git-common-dir>/reconverge-quarantine/<ts>/`, retry the merge once (both parents kept). Every
other failure — incl. a genuine content conflict — keeps today's abort-only behavior exactly.

**Scope & safety** — `_union_merge` callers are internal to `sync.py` (reconverge only), which
ignores the return; only-incidental, no behavioral dependency on abort-only. Restores the
non-destructive reconverge invariant (no new entry point); stdlib-only (`shutil`/`datetime`/
`pathlib`, already used); weakened no existing test. Lint + typecheck clean; only pre-existing
`safe.bareRepository` env failures in the suite (fail identically on pristine origin/main).

**Siblings** — Parity census names one MISSING slot: the push non-fast-forward recovery path
(`push_recovery.py`) has the same untracked-collision wedge → filed **sulfuryl-suicidal-osprey**
(discovered_from). Compaction crash-atomicity (don't produce the dirty tree) → filed
**compulsory-pernickety-mantis** (discovered_from). Both deferred to keep this certified-scope
change small.

**Replication** — Original report resolved: store converged, writes round-trip, akitainu
attestation on origin. Fix lands via Gerrit 1757 (pending LLM-Review +1 AND Verified +1).

**Residual risk** — The ~89 other shared-store worktrees each still carry their own dirty
working tree (latent re-wedge until each reconverges cleanly); the reconverge fix self-heals
them on next sync. parity-scan / digital-service-orchestra are separate products' stores (same
bug class, out of scope; d-s-o had ahead=0). Disposition: covered by change 1757 + the two
filed follow-ups.
